content.json:
# SOC Operations Workbook

Workbook for Sentinel incident health, noisy analytics rules, and Logic App playbook execution visibility.

> Replace `{SubscriptionId}`, `{ResourceGroup}`, and `{WorkspaceName}` during deployment or select your Sentinel workspace when editing the workbook.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize IncidentCount=count() by Severity, Status
| order by IncidentCount desc
content.title: Sentinel Incidents by Severity and Status

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize IncidentCount=count(), LatestIncident=max(TimeGenerated) by Title
| top 20 by IncidentCount desc
content.title: Noisy Analytics Rules

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.LOGIC"
| summarize Runs=count(), Failures=countif(status_s =~ "Failed") by Resource, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Logic App Playbook Execution Health

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Severity in ("High", "Critical")
| project TimeGenerated, Title, Severity, Status, Owner, IncidentNumber
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Recent High Severity Incidents
